title: Functor category
description: JSON Schema for a functor category [C, D] — the category whose objects are functors C → D and whose morphisms are natural transformations between them (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. II §4; Awodey 2010 §7.5). Specializes category. The hom-set [C, D](F, G) is the set of natural transformations F ⇒ G.

source-category.description: The source category C — functors in this functor category have C as their source.

target-category.description: The target category D — functors in this functor category have D as their target.
